purpose: Successor candidate for the bundled pinned rustc_driver semantic sidecar. It repairs the seven exact independent v1 pre-freeze rejection findings while preserving the accepted v1 transport, custody, lifecycle, Coverage, offline and conditional-D9 decisions. It is architecture-contract evidence only.

dependencyPins.selector: PLAN-ID-V1, SnapshotId and closed rust-v1 universe
exact fact-derivation stage, boundedParameterValue, canonicalIdentifier and PlanId tag 10
FactCandidateV1, relation ladders, universeRule and Coverage key
conditional candidate finalization vocabulary and exact golden cases
independent PASS for the exact not-applied D9 candidate bytes

limitPolicy.comparison: Every inclusive numeric bound is enforced at its named boundary. An extra, missing, renamed, negative, boolean, floating or out-of-uint64 limits field rejects Hello before HelloAck.
limitPolicy.arithmetic: All count, offset, payload, file, blob, candidate and aggregate additions use checked uint64 arithmetic. Overflow faults before allocation or append and never saturates or wraps.
limitPolicy.allocation: Read and validate the eight-byte frame length before allocating its payload. Validate each declared chunk/blob/count and checked next aggregate before allocating or extending the corresponding host buffer, VFS file or spool entry.

candidateSpoolAccounting.entryShape: the closed map {analysisOrdinal,stageId,candidate}, where candidate is the exact recursively validated FactCandidateV1 wire value
candidateSpoolAccounting.includedBytes: exact byte length of RFC-8949 deterministic-CBOR(entryShape), including every map/array/text/byte-string header, map key, stageId, analysisOrdinal and candidate byte
excludedBytes: the FactBatch wrapper and sibling candidates
allocator capacity, alignment, filesystem metadata and implementation bookkeeping
candidateSpoolAccounting.order: After canonical payload and candidate validation but before allocating or writing the spool entry, compute entryBytes, checked-add it to runningCandidateSpoolBytes, and reject the entire Analyze if the addition overflows or exceeds maxCandidateSpoolBytes. Independently checked-add one to maxFactCandidatesTotal before append.
candidateSpoolAccounting.encodingRule: The entry is encoded directly from the validated semantic value; slicing received frame bytes, using JSON, omitting keys or using allocator size is forbidden. The empty spool is zero bytes.

limitPolicy.aggregateAccounting: Request/response payload totals include exact canonical-CBOR envelope payload bytes and exclude each 40-byte transport prefix. Snapshot total counts declared file content bytes; prepared-output total counts exact blob bytes; neither includes frame wrappers.
limitPolicy.semanticBudgetSeparation: Safety-bound, arithmetic, allocation, spool, scratch, process-deadline and aggregate failures are provider-protocol faults. They cannot manufacture BudgetExhausted.

limitsHandshake.numericProjection: The top-level limits object is the sole ProtocolLimitsV2 value and contains exactly the 24 required uint64 numeric fields. limitPolicy is not a member of that value.
limitsHandshake.semanticEquality: HelloV2.limits and this artifact's limits object must have exact recursive type-and-value equality; booleans are not integers.
limitsHandshake.byteEquality: deterministic-CBOR(HelloV2.limits) must equal deterministic-CBOR(this artifact's limits) byte-for-byte before Hello is written and again before HelloAck is accepted.
limitsHandshake.forkRule: A producer or consumer adding limitRule, policyId or any other policy member to ProtocolLimitsV2, omitting a numeric member, or accepting a locally defaulted value is protocol-major-incompatible.

framing.frameBytes: exactly uint64-big-endian payloadLength, then 32 raw SHA-256 digest bytes, then payloadLength canonical-CBOR payload bytes
framing.digestScope: SHA-256 of the exact canonical-CBOR payload bytes only
framing.allocationRule: Reject length above maxFramePayloadBytes before payload allocation; then read exactly digest and payload with checked aggregate accounting.
framing.stdoutRule: stdout is protocol-only from child start through EOF. A non-frame byte, truncation, digest mismatch, noncanonical payload or post-terminal byte is provider-protocol.
framing.eofRule: EOF is valid only in WAIT_EOF after one valid worker terminal and observed zero exit.

canonicalCbor.mapOrder: Sort keys first by byte length of the deterministic-CBOR encoded text key, then lexicographically by those unsigned encoded bytes.
canonicalCbor.decodeRule: Retain payload bytes, reject duplicate/noncanonical input, decode once under the selected closed schema, re-encode and require byte equality.

schemaLanguage.maps: closed=true means exactly required fields plus only explicitly listed optional fields; nullable is present null, not omission
schemaLanguage.arrays: definite arrays preserve order unless an exact sorted-unique rule is declared
schemaLanguage.integer: exact nonnegative CBOR major-type-0 integer; boolean is not integer
schemaLanguage.text: exact NFC UTF-8 text satisfying byte bound, enum, equality or pattern
schemaLanguage.bytes: exact CBOR byte string satisfying its bound
schemaLanguage.external: recursively validate against the exact hash-pinned dependency bytes and selector
schemaLanguage.union: select one named variant and enforce its exact field set

commitments.preparedOutputBlob: hex(SHA-256(deterministic-CBOR(PreparedOutputBlobV2))) and exactly the corresponding rust-v1 outputDigest

planAndDomainProjection.owner: host analysis-domain constructor; the provider can only echo and answer the domain
planAndDomainProjection.selectedStageRule: Select all and only verified ExecutionPlan stages whose exact C-2 value has kind=fact-derivation, operator=semantic-provider and providerId=rust-semantic, preserving verified ExecutionPlan order.
planAndDomainProjection.planStageByteRule: StageRequestV2.planStage is the exact closed C-2 stage value with optional members present only when present in ExecutionPlan. deterministic-CBOR(planStage) must equal deterministic-CBOR(the selected ExecutionPlan stage) byte-for-byte; no subjects, Coverage keys, defaults or private fields are inserted into it.
planAndDomainProjection.sourceUniverseIdAlgorithm: sha256:hex(SHA-256(UTF8(opensip.rust-provider.universe.v2) || 0x00 || deterministic-CBOR(the complete selected rust-v1 universe value)))
planAndDomainProjection.allSemanticUniverseIdAlgorithm: For every PlanId tag-9 semanticUniverses row, compute sha256:hex(SHA-256(UTF8(opensip.semantic-universe.v2) || 0x00 || deterministic-CBOR({providerId,providerVersion,universe}))); sort unique IDs by UTF-8 bytes. The selected rust source ID above replaces the generic ID for its rust-semantic row and is included exactly once.
subjectsAlgorithm: Read the fully validated SnapshotManifest entries committed by SnapshotId.
Select every file-kind entry whose CanonicalPath ends with the exact ASCII suffix .rs and whose byteLength is greater than zero.
Sort by path UTF-8 bytes; reject duplicate paths and reject before child spawn if the result is empty or exceeds maxSubjectsPerStage.
Every selected Rust stage receives the same exact subjects array for the same PlanId and SnapshotManifest.
coverageDomainAlgorithm: For each selected stage independently, traverse planStage.relations in its exact C-2 order.
For each relation, traverse every rung in that relation's hash-pinned FACT-PLANE ladder in weakest-first array order; no implementation may choose only the highest rung.
Read that relation's hash-pinned relation-payload schema universeRule. For same-only use exactly [sourceUniverseId]. For admitted-target use the complete sorted semantic-universe ID array above.

For each target in that order, emit one exact C-2 Coverage key {relation,resolution,sourceUniverseId,targetUniverseId,subjectScopeCommitment,producer:'rust-semantic',producerVersion:verified providerBuildId,schemaVersion:the relation payload registry schemaVersion}.
The nested-loop order relation, rung, target is canonical. Reject duplicate keys, an empty result, or more than maxRequestedCoverageKeysPerStage before child spawn.
planAndDomainProjection.sameInputsRule: SnapshotId, exact manifest entries, PlanId tag-9 semanticUniverses, PlanId tag-11 planStage and verified providerBuildId are the complete inputs. Equal inputs must produce byte-identical subjects, Coverage keys and domainCommitment in all implementations.
planAndDomainProjection.wireRule: StageRequestV2.analysisDomain must equal a fresh host reconstruction from those inputs both recursively and in deterministic-CBOR bytes. A Plan-bound value is never accepted merely because the provider or an earlier mutable adapter supplied it.
planAndDomainProjection.independentDerivationRequirement: Conformance reconstructs the domain once by the normative nested-loop algorithm and once by an independently structured cartesian product over frozen dependency rows; both bytes must equal each other and the request.

repositoryExecution.default: disabled; no build scripts, procedural macros, compiler plugins or project hooks execute
repositoryExecution.preparedOwner: host resolved-inputs adapter after Snapshot seal and before PlanId construction; it is network-disabled and terminates before semantic child launch
repositoryExecution.planBinding: Tool paths enter PLAN-ID-V1 tag 10 through the exact C-2-valid grant parameters. Prepared output bytes enter PLAN-ID-V1 tag 9 because each ordered rust-v1 buildScriptOutputs/procMacroOutputs row outputDigest is defined by the v2 join as SHA-256 of its exact closed byte-bearing PreparedOutputBlobV2; the blob excludes outputDigest and therefore has no self-reference.
repositoryExecution.semanticChild: receives the exact blobs over protocol frames, validates them, and reads their content only through the sealed read-only prepared-output VFS

requestProjection.identity: Hello identity comes from the verified signed release and complete Plan rust-v1 value; OpenUniverse carries the complete rust-v1 value
requestProjection.snapshot: one complete path-sorted manifest, exact in-order file chunks, then seal; symlink target bytes remain in the manifest
requestProjection.preparedOutputs: for prepared mode, one complete manifest, exact ordinal/chunk ordered blob bytes, then seal and exact acceptance before Analyze
requestProjection.stage: Analyze contains each exact nested C-2 planStage plus the deterministic host-owned analysisDomain
requestProjection.sourceDisclosure: No SnapshotManifest, SnapshotFileChunk or prepared-output content is sent before exact HelloAck capability/identity equality and exact UniverseAccepted echo.

CanonicalPath.rule: NFC slash-relative path; no leading slash, backslash, NUL, drive prefix, empty, dot or dot-dot segment

ProtocolLimitsV2.rule: Every member is uint64 and the complete map is exact semantic and deterministic-CBOR equality with top-level limits.

variants.prepared: mode=prepared; grantId non-null; network=false; output rows exact rust-v1; toolPaths exact tag-10 tool_paths; commitment equals deterministic prepared manifest reconstructed from committed blobs

preparedOutputCustody.order: SnapshotAccepted, then when repositoryResolution.mode=prepared PreparedOutputManifest, zero or more PreparedOutputChunk, PreparedOutputSeal, PreparedOutputAccepted, then Analyze. Disabled mode goes directly from SnapshotAccepted to Analyze.
preparedOutputCustody.manifestConstruction: Concatenate exact rust-v1 buildScriptOutputs rows followed by procMacroOutputs rows. Each row has exactly one blob. Decode each fully received canonical blob, validate its variant/row/path/content, then derive the exact PreparedOutputEntryV2. The ordered entries and commitment have one possible value.
preparedOutputCustody.planCommitmentProof: PLAN-ID-V1 tag 9 commits the ordered rust-v1 rows. Each outputDigest is exactly SHA-256 of a closed byte-bearing blob and the row independently supplies its owner/configuration identity; the digest commits kind, owner/configuration and content bytes, while ordinal and digest deterministically define logicalPath. Entry sizes and content digest are deterministic functions of committed bytes; therefore the complete manifest is a unique reconstruction of Plan-bound values, not an opaque parallel authority.
preparedOutputCustody.transfer: Chunks carry every exact blob byte. A digest-only row, absent byte, missing/duplicate/reordered ordinal or chunk, wrong size/digest/path/row, unknown field, reference, cycle, external lookup or uncommitted blob rejects before PreparedOutputAccepted.
preparedOutputCustody.readAuthority: After acceptance the host mounts only each validated content byte string at its manifest logicalPath in the child's sealed read-only prepared-output VFS. No live root, CAS, file descriptor, host path, callback, network or side channel is supplied.
preparedOutputCustody.lifecycle: Prepared output bytes remain child-private, bounded, non-durable and are erased with snapshot VFS and scratch after every terminal/fault. The semantic child executes no project or preparation code.

admitOn: exact stage, candidate and Coverage order/bijection
candidateAtomicity.admission: Atomically admit the complete Analyze candidate set and Coverage only after every condition succeeds.
candidateAtomicity.discardAllOn: every other terminal, cancellation, process/protocol fault or safety bound
candidateAtomicity.unavailableAndBudgetCoverage: Only a valid terminal plus exhaustive unknown Coverage plus zero exit/EOF may admit terminal Coverage; candidates remain discarded.

deterministicBudget.milliseconds: host deadline only; never authorizes BudgetExhausted
deterministicBudget.work-units: checked increment before each canonical tuple (stage,subjectOrdinal,Coverage entryOrdinal)
deterministicBudget.items: checked increment before staging each candidate
deterministicBudget.bytes: checked increment by exact deterministic-CBOR candidate byte length before staging

fieldSchemas.payloadValid: boolean produced only after exact closed-schema validation plus every wireSchema field equality, retained-session identity, manifest/chunk/order, stage attribution, FactCandidate, Coverage bijection and commitment rule not represented by the explicit machine counters; false takes framePrecheck.onReject

actionGrammar.overflow: set phase=FAULT and apply no partial action

determinismConditions.fallback: T028 lists every non-FAULT phase and every event kind; T028 is last
determinismConditions.fault: FAULT is the sole absorbing phase

generatedExplanation: Analyze requires a non-empty stage array and assigns stageCount exactly to its length.
A stage may emit zero FactBatch frames, then its exact Coverage; one and multiple stages reach READY_COMPLETE by T017/T018.
Unavailable is accepted only by T019 before any FactBatch or Coverage; BudgetExhausted is accepted only by T020 for a matching non-milliseconds stage budget.
ProviderFault and Cancel use exact enumerated phase sets. Zero exit, EOF, nonzero exit, deadline, unframed bytes and every post-terminal event have exact rules or the total fallback.

modelCheckDomain.requiredEquality: state-by-state exact record equality for every explored event

responseProjection.candidate: recursively validate every FACT-PLANE candidate against exact stage/domain/snapshot; provider never mints FACT-ID
responseProjection.coverage: each successful stage emits one exact ordered complete bijection; Unavailable/BudgetExhausted carry exhaustive stage-major unknown Coverage
responseProjection.terminalObservation: Complete, Unavailable, BudgetExhausted, ProviderFault and Cancelled are provider observations only. In particular Unavailable/BudgetExhausted do not decide D9 requiredness.
responseProjection.typedFault: ProviderFault detailCode is diagnostic and always normalizes to provider-protocol.

d9Join.rule: The host first validates a provider observation, then the host finalizer combines it with C-1 predicate-relative sufficiency, admitted requiredness, other Coverage, verdict, durability, required postconditions and interruption timing. No provider frame contains or selects a public D9 class/code.

conformanceCorpus.checkerRule: Hash dependencies before semantic use; import no producer oracle; use independent fixed fixtures; recursively validate exact types and C-2 bounded values; model-check the concrete machine; reconstruct prepared bytes/domains/D9/reducer; refuse dirty selftest base; count mutation apply/no-op/duplicate/ambiguity/skip escapes; ignore pyc.

residuals: Exact-byte independent review of this five-file v2 set is required.
Formal application to DELIVERY, RESOLVED-INPUTS and D9 v1.13 is outside this candidate.
Rust host, rustc_driver child, repository-resolution adapter, corpus runs, product implementation, platform qualification and release evidence remain unexecuted.
Cryptographic commitments assume SHA-256 collision resistance; a collision is a host integrity fault, never a fallback lookup.
